blocks.text: Zoning and planning in Morgan Creek

parts.t: Morgan Creek is a mature, built-out community, so the useful question is what the rules allow on a specific lot.
Zoning is set by the City of Surrey and varies by lot. Check the zone and permitted uses for the exact address.

Provincial SSMUH (small-scale multi-unit housing) legislation requires municipalities to allow more housing types on single-family lots. How that applies to a particular lot depends on its zone, size, servicing and site constraints.
Golf-course and creekside lots can carry covenants, rights of way or environmental setbacks that limit where you can build.
Do not assume what a neighbour built or renovated is possible on your lot.
Sources: City of Surrey zoning bylaw and the provincial SSMUH legislation. Always confirm current rules with the City.

blocks.text: Before you buy in Morgan Creek

parts.t: Ask the City what the property is zoned and what that allows.
Check covenants and rights of way, especially on golf-course and creekside lots.
Look at the lot, not just the house.
Orientation, privacy, slope and any streamside or environmental setbacks affect what you can do.
In larger custom homes, get a thorough inspection and ask about major systems.
It is set by address, so check with Surrey Schools, and ask about Southridge School if private school is on your list.
I’ll show you how Morgan Creek stacks up against Morgan Crossing, Grandview Heights and Elgin Chantrell for your budget.
Send me your address and I’ll give you a call to talk about how to get the most value from your home.
Morgan Creek is in South Surrey, in the City of Surrey. It is centrally located, with quick access to White Rock Beach, Highway 99 and the U.S. border.
What kind of homes are in Morgan Creek?
Mostly established, large custom-built homes on private lots, many with golf-course views or fairway access, plus a small number of townhomes. Lot sizes vary, so check each property.

Can I renovate, add a suite or build more on a Morgan Creek lot?
It depends on the lot’s zone, size, covenants and site constraints. Provincial SSMUH rules also apply. Send me the address and I’ll check what is realistic before you buy.

Can I play Morgan Creek Golf Course if I do not live there?
Yes. It is a public course, with a driving range, a golf academy and Morgans Restaurant and Wine Bar on site. Check
